jobs.prompt: Regression from T-8006 in tools/watch-server.mjs: the /api/health route (added in 1.165.0 for the safe server restart on update) must answer BEFORE the token check, exactly as on main: right after `const pathname = u.pathname;`, `if (pathname === '/api/health') { if (remote || !local) return 421; host name must be 127.0.0.1 or localhost else 421; return sendJson({ ok: true, version, pid }) }` with no token required. T-8006 moved it below the token gate (isHealth in the 404 allow-list and a second block after the token check), so the update's restart confirmation fails. Restore the main placement, remove isHealth from the later token-gated path, and change nothing else. Add one assertion to tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs: GET /api/health on loopback with no token returns 200 with only ok, version and pid, and a request with a non-loopback Host gets 421. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/server-restart.test.mjs tests/server-restart-review.test.mjs tests/server-restart-round2.test.mjs tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
